name: Complexity-Based Model Selection
description: Implements intelligent model selection based on PRD complexity, automatically routing simple work to Haiku, complex work to Opus, and balanced work to Sonnet. Reduces costs by 15-30% while improving success rates on complex tasks.

context.problem: All PRDs default to Sonnet regardless of complexity. Simple fixes waste expensive tokens on over-powered models, while complex architecture work struggles with cost-optimized models. User runs 40-50 PRDs/day across 5 repos, making this inefficiency multiply across portfolio.
context.impact: Opus costs 5x Sonnet, Sonnet costs 12x Haiku. Mismatched model selection wastes budget on simple tasks and risks failure on complex tasks. No learning feedback loop to improve routing decisions.
context.opportunity: Smart routing could reduce costs 15-30% by using Haiku for simple work, while improving quality on complex work with Opus reasoning.

solution: Add complexity classification to PRD schema with heuristic analyzer. Route work based on complexity: simple→Haiku, complex→Opus, medium→Sonnet. Log decisions to enable learning. Allow manual override with --model flag.

userStories.title: Add complexity field to PRD schema
userStories.description: As a FADE user, I want to specify PRD complexity so intelligent routing can select the right model.
acceptanceCriteria: Add optional 'complexity' field to PRD JSON schema (values: 'simple', 'medium', 'complex')
If missing, defaults to 'medium' (current behavior preserved)
fade new --complexity=simple creates PRD with complexity field
fade new without flag prompts: 'Complexity? [simple/Medium/complex]'
Validate complexity value in PRD schema (reject invalid values)
Display complexity in fade status output: '[simple] ENH-014' vs '[complex] FEAT-012'

userStories.title: Heuristic complexity analyzer
userStories.description: As FADE, I want to suggest complexity based on PRD content so users don't have to classify manually.
acceptanceCriteria: Create analyze_complexity() function in bin/fade-cli
Heuristic rules: Count acceptance criteria (AC count > 15 = complex, < 5 = simple)
Heuristic rules: Check for keywords ('architecture', 'refactor', 'integrate', 'migrate' → complex)
Heuristic rules: Check for keywords ('typo', 'fix', 'update docs', 'add test' → simple)
Heuristic rules: Check estimatedEffort field ('>1 week' → complex, '<4 hours' → simple)
Heuristic rules: Check dependsOn array (dependencies > 2 → complex)
fade new suggests complexity: 'Suggested complexity: complex (15 ACs, contains "architecture")'
User can accept or override suggestion
Log heuristic reasoning to learned.md for review

userStories.title: Intelligent model routing
userStories.description: As FADE, I want to route PRDs to appropriate models based on complexity so costs are optimized and quality improves.
acceptanceCriteria: Update cmd_run() to read complexity field from PRD
Routing logic: complexity='simple' AND no --model override → use haiku
Routing logic: complexity='complex' AND no --model override → use opus
Routing logic: complexity='medium' OR missing → use sonnet (default)
Routing logic: --model flag always overrides complexity-based routing
Routing logic: FADE_MODEL env var overrides complexity, but --model flag overrides both
Display selected model in iteration banner: 'Iteration 1 - model: haiku (complexity: simple)'
Log routing decision to progress.md: 'Model selection: haiku (complexity=simple, no override)'

technicalNotes.implementation: Pure bash, extend existing cmd_run() and cmd_new()

technicalNotes.backward_compatibility: Missing complexity field defaults to 'medium' (Sonnet), preserving current behavior
technicalNotes.override_precedence: --model flag > FADE_MODEL env var > complexity routing > default (sonnet)

risks.risk: Heuristic misclassifies PRDs, routes complex work to Haiku
risks.mitigation: Conservative defaults (if uncertain, use sonnet). User can override with --model. Log classifications to learned.md for review and tuning.

risks.risk: Cost estimates are inaccurate, mislead users
risks.mitigation: Clearly label as estimates, use for trend analysis not billing. Note: 'Estimates based on context size, not actual API usage.'
